job_roles.name: Controls Group Lead
job_roles.description:
Controls Group Lead
Job Description

Department: Electrical Controls
Reports to: Technical Director
Direct Reports: Welding Controls Engineer, Controls Technician 
Date Created: 6.11.2024

SUMMARY

This position will lead plant activities in regards to both a new product development and sustaining standpoint along with providing plant engineering / controls builds support in the integration, calibration, design, and testing of PLC-based control systems.  Also provides advanced technical, analytical, problem solving and validation support to electrical/automated systems throughout the manufacturing plant.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Personnel Responsibilities
•	Supervise, train and provide technical direction to controls team members
Quality, Delivery, Productivity, and Continuous Improvement Responsibilities
•	Proposes, specifies, designs, programs, and implements electrical controls and automation systems for the manufacturing facility
•	PLC Programming (ladder logic) on a variety of platforms including Allen-Bradley, Automation Direct / Koyo Processors
•	Performs root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, repair, and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment including packaging machinery and processing equipment, networked systems and complex integrated systems
•	Responsible for project management of moderate complexity involving other corporate and/or contract resources
•	Available to provide after-hours telephone and on-site troubleshooting assistance for plant electrical, engineering, and production departments
•	Plan and implement research methodology and procedures to apply principles of electrical theory to engineering projects
•	Prepare specifications for purchase of materials and equipment
Safety Responsibilities
•	Reviews technical specifications and schematics for new and existing equipment to ensure that sound engineering practices are followed and that machine build standards, NFPA, NEC, and MIOSHA requirements are met
•	Reports unsafe conditions and injuries to the immediate supervisor
•	Refrains from any unsafe act that might endanger themselves or a co-worker
•	Uses all safety devices provided for protection and complies with existing policies
•	Works according to good safety practices as posted, instructed and discussed
•	Adhere to all ISO 14001/TS 16949 requirements and safety regulations

Duties stated are not intended to be all inclusive and may require some temporary or miscellaneous work assignments as requested by their supervisor or other management.


SKILLS REQUIRED 
•	Demonstrate strong programming skills particularly with PLC programming, ladder logic design and experience with HMI stations 
•	Programming of VFD’s (variable frequency drives) and Servo’s
•	Strong oral and written communication
•	AutoCAD electrical and graphing skills
•	Prioritization of work assignments for self and others in a fast-paced work environment
•	Excellent electro/mechanical aptitude
Representation of Tube Fab’s values
•	Quality: Pursuing excellence in everything we do
•	Integrity: Doing what we say and treating others how we want to be treated
•	Innovation: Passionate about developing better methods for tomorrow 
•	Service: Daily earning the trust of our customer, co-workers, and community 
 
 
EDUCATION + KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS
•	Knowledge of AutoCAD / AutoCAD Electrical software
•	Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Instrumentation  OR High School diploma and specialized training certifications required
•	Demonstrates an understanding of instrumentation, meters, reading of PID’s, and proper wiring techniques
•	Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
•	Supervisory experience preferred
•	5+ years of experience working with a variety of control systems in a manufacturing environment 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS 
•	Required to sit for extended periods of time without leaving the work area
•	Ability to coordinate the eyes, hands and feet with each other in response to visual stimuli


Reasonable accommodations are available to candidates and employees who need them.

Tube Fab Roman Engineering is an equal opportunity employer.

job_roles.name: Human Resources Manager
job_roles.description:
Human Resources Manager
Job Description 

Department: Human Resources
Reports to: General Manager
Direct Reports: N/A

SUMMARY
The Human Resources Manager oversees HR responsibilities, including recruitment, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding of new staff. This role is also responsible for managing training systems and serving as a strategic advisor to executive leadership. Acting as a vital link between organizational management and employees, the HR Manager fosters a collaborative, compliant, and innovative workplace culture.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

People
•	Guide employees through policies and procedures, addressing questions with clarity and empathy.
•	Provide strategic insights and support to the executive team on organizational planning and people strategies.
•	Assist employees with navigating and maximizing their benefits.

Processes
•	Strengthen organizational capabilities by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations programs, HR policies, and best practices.
•	Maintain accurate and up-to-date job descriptions and role requirements for all positions.
•	Oversee the recruitment and selection process, offering counsel to hiring managers and conducting data-driven evaluations of recruiting practices.
•	Enhance employee performance and engagement by supporting managers in coaching, employee development, and addressing performance challenges.
•	Ensure legal and regulatory compliance through consistent monitoring, timely investigations, accurate recordkeeping, and representation at hearings.
•	Develop HR policies, ensuring they align with organizational values and strategic goals.
•	Maintain a secure system for managing historical and current human resource records.
•	Assessing future needs and talent gaps.
•	Intermediate and long-range succession management.
•	Training and development strategy to meet those needs.
•	Talent pipeline (i.e. working with schools, managers, etc. on identifying and meeting future needs).

Professional Qualities:
•	Embody a leadership style focused on empowering and developing others.
•	Demonstrate a high degree of emotional intelligence, ethical integrity, and trustworthiness.
•	Operate as a trusted business partner, balancing confidentiality and organizational priorities.
•	Foster collaboration and respect by valuing diverse perspectives and iterative learning.
•	Approach decision-making holistically, considering the broader implications and innovative alternatives.
Duties stated are not intended to be all inclusive and may require some temporary or miscellaneous work assignments as requested by their supervisor or other management.

SKILLS
•	Proven servant leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop teams.
•	Exceptional interpersonal skills, adept at communicating across all organizational levels and diverse audiences.
•	Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
•	Analytical mindset with creative problem-solving capabilities.
•	Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or related HR software platforms.
Representation of Tube Fab’s values
•	Quality: Pursuing excellence in everything we do.
•	Integrity: Doing what we say and treating others how we want to be treated.
•	Innovation: Passionate about developing better methods for tomorrow. 
•	Service: Daily earning the trust of our customer, co-workers, and community. 
Representation of Shingo Principles

•	Lead with humility
•	Focus on Process
•	Embrace Scientific Thinking
•	Seek Perfection
•	Improve Flow and Pull
•	Assure Quality at the Source
•	Think Systematically
•	Create constancy of Purpose
•	Create value for the customer

•	Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent work experience considered.
•	PHR/SPHR/SHRM certification preferred.
•	Familiarity with ISO 9001-2008, TS 16949, and ISO 14001 standards is a plus.
